My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

an incredible night

| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675601%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XdJvBDGshUjBrkQTLUzXrQ&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

Wednesday night I finished my first Presidential Debate, and it was incredible!

Whether it was tackling out-of-control spending, securing our border, taking on China and Russia, standing up for our girls, or laying out my plan to make America strong and proud, I made sure to have an honest discussion with the American people.

We need a new generation of leadership in the White House, and I am ready to get to work.

We have a country to save, but I need your help to make that happen.

**[Can I count on your support so we can reach every American with my message, win the White House, and SAVE our future?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675602%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9tn104iyjkRel9y%2bDpkK%2bw&sysid=1 "Can I count on your
support so we can reach every American with my message, win the White House, and
SAVE our future?")**
| | | [DONATE NOW](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675603%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YOPeEHSLdbObBfvS8%2bQWng&sysid=1)
---

Friend, in the greatest nation in history, 78% of our country is worried their kids won’t be better off. That is NOT okay.

My parents came here more than 50 years ago to an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. _I want them to see America again. _

When we focus on faith, family, and the fact that America is the best country in the world, that's when our best days are ahead of us.

**[I’m putting in the work. Will you join me in the fight for our country’s future?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675604%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fgRO4asG%2bLXa8bExK4UNYg&sysid=1 "I’m putting in the work.
Will you join me in the fight for our country’s future? ")**

**[If you agree with my vision for our country’s future- an America that is STRONG and PROUD, NOT WEAK and WOKE - please rush in a donation today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675615%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=n0%2bB3sPxhOWkk07zeq0f0Q&sysid=1 "If you agree with my
vision for our country’s future – an America that is STRONG and PROUD, NOT
WEAK and WOKE – please rush in a donation today.")**

We’ve got a country to save, and with you on my side, that’s exactly what we’re going to do.

---
My very best,

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675618%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6ItSmkOPvDx1oQlxuw5JJw&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675619%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7Qjxefz5DbmNelPxIBbGVw&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

## US Suspects Putin Behind Prigozhin's Death

The intelligence community in the U.S., however, is [very suspicious](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOqzAQheGngc6RZ2yMKVzcJl1uuyUazBgmcgAZb6Ldp19l6y2PTvPp_7iNN5Is2_KfHhxq2keKVZ48aq-wU2hGbOeQmJFNywHcgEOPbtDtGkBPnj31JiZIeoDUD8ROTxNwBBOxlYAajfbYARqP-mK7zns3Y2_tBADQWM2z1L1c7rtsdeWUv_Ynl0vcH20Oa63H2Zh_DV4bvNKx8et8X-9RqsTMDV7L53kKqRctGxd1FFn271U2deeqYqFzVeYN6BBscgOw7WciZONMNzvLDrAtYT5ekrOcrm-sXh4k-ZdQ_y7yEwAA__8w1l_d) that the explosion was ordered by the Russian president in retaliation against Prigozhin for threatening Putin's 23-year rule. ## Details Emerge of Maui Horrors
Survivors of the Lahaina fire are [telling their stories](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGP4yAQRn-N3RENA7ahoLgmXa690hrDEM8tNpHNJtp_v8rW-3WfXvP0_t3mG0mR_f6XNg4t15likyfP4BQOCs2MfQqZGdn0HPTo0U84eujXEGlA79jbZI0xtGRnQY8u6aw9ELheAgIacDhoNA7hYofBuTHhZO2itdadBU7S6nH5X2VvK-fyVZ98XGLd-hLW1h5nZ_50eO3wSo-dX-cbvc_RJBbu8LrSi0RUloNP1WTjIjurjT5FFVpJdlJHpaSWUuOHim7A9_KYeHDTkrRdMBEAQrTAvj9CerykFDnHqbNw30jKj077vc53AAAA__9qvGPH), including chilling details of people being trapped by barricades as they tried to escape the hellscape around them. Downed powerlines and the subsequently closed roads created choke points, making it difficult for many to escape the flames. "_Nobody realized how little time we really had_ ," one survivor said. "_Like even us being from the heart of the fire, we did not comprehend. Like, we literally had minutes and one wrong turn. We would all be dead right now_." Residents who narrowly survived the fire took measures into their own hands by plowing through roadblocks or driving off-road altogether to get to safety. Others, including many children home from school without parents, had no idea a fire was raging and didn't get out in time. Maui officials, including the Chief of Police, are [defending their response](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOrCAUgOGnwQ4DB1QoKG5jN7eZbLY0CEfnbFAmyGjm7Te79dZ_8-f7vE03T4n29b_f0NUlTz5UOnEShkPHQU3QRLcgAqoGnewt2AF6K5qHAzErEeaggxq0sLILGKyxOhjRWb_EhhwIUMJAJ0EZEK3uOmP6CIPWs5RSMi0wUs2l_cq01wcu6Z1PLG3IW5Pco9bnwdQ_BiOD0c9hx-to1_yTGYwfdwbjRQXvNZc3gzGij-nNN_8ivlDBg1--7LSvPOa4YuSzL4WCj3jw41VOOjFyKUAPste6KS4-L0qJjn5gWqybp_R7Uv-G-Q4AAP__GhNkFg) to the wildfire, but they remain under intense scrutiny as the full picture of the event develops.

I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future. Will you join me today and help me save our country? [View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zqrl51mk2fegifpu5ll62in5vjkpgoe6b2vhbmlg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65thimlgrdd5ie9hjco9gelg7atblc3i62pj4mjg7ac726pge4thke9j72odkcqrjfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj35c5jcjjreoj66pgb6p9nm2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm9oj4s3h61oj7c8iv0)

Fellow American,

When I stepped off the stage, I could feel electricity in the air. _This campaign has built tremendous momentum and we aren't letting up for a minute._

For those of you who have been with me since the beginning, you know how big tonight's victory is. We started this campaign back in late February polling at 0.0%. My vision is for an America more unified by our founding ideals than torn apart by our perceived differences.

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z2o0mai87q0eggcub01ktedcnasa527ps9vs9v58_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge4o72cth2bs)
---

My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different:
* I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world – not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus – will defeat us.

**[Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 20 weeks until the first primary election. Chip in $20 today and together, let's make America our first priority.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2za2d3gdccsl6isgba98cgl2ipgdgr5461me1o49g_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge4o72cth2bs)**

_Fellow American – are you ready for the revolution?_

America First,

[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zd2i7der7nf0tlgjnjba31gp086k681rgo885gv8_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge4o72cth2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT →**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z41q65nuuifjtttrt2pa29gnp6h3q5gah2nl0h50_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge4o72cth2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z3tp3mt3mp4ca1bnhelu91fgiq49jnt1tg4hkq88_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge4o72cth2bs)

Peter,
This country doesn’t need partisan games, grandstanding, or any other kind of self-serving shenanigans from their elected officials.
They need Congressmen and women who are willing to put politics aside for the good of the people they represent.

They need Congressmen and women who are willing to put politics aside for the good of the people they represent. That’s exactly what I did when I met with President Biden when he traveled to the Hudson Valley in May. I urged him to work with Speaker McCarthy on a bipartisan solution to the debt ceiling – work with, negotiate, compromise – whatever it takes to deliver positive results for the American people. We also discussed the border crisis, and I told him point-blank that something’s got to change. Mayor Adams’ unilateral decision to ship unvetted adult male migrants from New York City to the Hudson Valley was unacceptable. I explained how fixing our border is another opportunity for him to work with Republicans to get things done for you. This was a huge win for us, but we can’t let our guard down now! We need more common sense solutions that deliver for our district, keep people safe, and build towards a better future for the Hudson Valley. This is what I’m all about. There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.

August 25, 2023
Dear Friend,
Voters are ready for leadership that better reflects their values, goals, and priorities. That is why I am running for City Council, District 2. Winning in October starts NOW, and that is why we have been continuously working hard behind the scenes. We have received numerous endorsements, appeared in several newspaper articles, participated in lots of in-person events, distributed yard signs, and conducted text banking to reach our voters. Even as a working mom of three children who just started back to school, this campaign has been nonstop. But I cannot do it without your help.
CONTRIBUTE TO JERRI GREEN FOR CITY COUNCIL [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4XKxVHkB7UCbne-E5bbl6w2]
But the truth is I am facing a crowded field of competitors. It is only with your help I will be able to make history and become the first mother to hold this seat. This race is on everyone's radar because it is considered very flippable (the last person to hold the seat was the fundraising chair for Trump). But we need the resources to spread our message .
If you haven’t already, please take a minute to visit www.jerrigreen.com [http://www.jerrigreen.com] and then take the next step - give generously so we can win this fall [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4XKxVHkB7UCbne-E5bbl6w2] . Thanks in advance for your consideration and all you have already done to help my campaign.
Sincerely,
Jerri Green

body:
America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.

|
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsrt3ejvd8qm6em1ojf1h2i0pfqp357t3cqdg9ao_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge2or0cdh2bs)
Fellow American,

**TRUTH.** There's only one. Not yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic political climate where spin is all the Administrative state knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to say them:

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** deteABine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest foAB of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** CHIP IN IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfbl9uld7poequh62isc3c4o604uj8tts7ke7dn0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge2or0cdh2bs)
---

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred and undeniable. **Without these truths, our standing as a nation would mean nothing.**

If you agree with these 10 TRUTHS, _**[I need you on my team.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrrtmucj33jbgpgmhouphkankti026cvij3qgla0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge2or0cdh2bs)**_

This is about more than a campaign. It is a movement to revive this great nation. **[Will you join me today by chipping in $1 or more?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhvhj11j05671hqmihdv41h5nhd9u39egnp1kh1g_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge2or0cdh2bs)**

Thanks,

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2za968lst9gcjook2jt59p773lk0ut5o38vdbctq0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge2or0cdh2bs)

Vivek Ramaswamy

[** STAND WITH THE TRUTH **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z87cl8b5oso7kkskv4jgn40ip59r5fle67fo7978_rp22sh2s8i66p72cjge2or0cdh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a phaABaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based fiAB, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWNusz4DMN

Vivek 2024

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred
and undeniable. Without these truths, our standing as a nation
would mean nothing.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWNusz4DMN

Fellow American,

TRUTH. There's only one. Not
yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic
political climate where spin is all the Administrative state
knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to
say them:

God is real.
There are two
genders.
Human flourishing
requires fossil fuels.
Reverse racism is
racism.
An open border is no
border.
Parents determine the
education of their children.
The nuclear family is
the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
Capitalism lifts
people up from poverty.
There are three
branches of the U.S. government, not four.
The U.S. Constitution
is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.

CHIP IN
IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH

America was founded on these
truths that we find sacred and undeniable. Without these truths,
our standing as a nation would mean nothing.

If you agree with these 10
TRUTHS, I need you on my team.

This is about more than a
campaign. It is a movement to revive this great nation. Will you
join me today by chipping in $10 or more?

Thanks,

Vivek Ramaswamy

STAND WITH THE TRUTH

GET TO KNOW VIVEK:

Vivek is an
American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and
New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside
Corporate America's Social Justice Scam, along with his second
book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit,
and the Path Back to Excellence.

He has been a
prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory
practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he
calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes
with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do
through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a
first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he
often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that
"If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be
outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an
accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the
valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate
summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his
J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund,
then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where
his team developed five drugs that went on to become
FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded
Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct
aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and
others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth
of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the
voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading
companies to focus on excellence over politics.

STAND WITH VIVEK
➞

by Vivek 2024

Contributions to Vivek 2024 are
not deductible as charitable contributions for Federal income tax
purposes.

Funds received in response to

Contributions from corporations, labor unions, foreign nationals
without green cards, and federal government contractors are
prohibited. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to
collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and

name: Del. Lesley Lopez
subject: Being a parent can be terrifying
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lopez for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_logo [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamlesley_welcome?refcode2=img_logo]
Raising kids is scary, folks. Even if you do all you can to make sure your kids are healthy, safe, and loved, there are some things you will always feel powerless to protect them from.
I have two young kids in daycare, and on top of caring for my toddlers and their classmates, their teachers have to know what to do in the case of an active shooter.
As a delegate in the General Assembly, I know we’ve got some of the best gun safety laws in the country here in Maryland. But lax laws in other states leave glaring loopholes that put all of us at risk. We need more federal action to fix this.
I refuse to feel powerless when it comes to protecting my kids from gun violence. I refuse to feel powerless when it comes to protecting my kids from gun violence. If you’re with me, please add your name to my petition for federal action to pass commonsense gun safety laws to protect our families. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/26GGkGNw_EuSTCgDcYhKRA2?contactdata=uV68lnm/zPPdD90+OlDb20yKgIQIH+4q7Qh3Ys8PvdDiMLEk5moKZny39+kwEOm3/gscqCZPAr+4fZaQKuJtRD9JWEFqvC+kh9jY3gtg9FQ=&quick=true&refcode2=link_CTA1]
Sign the petition >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/26GGkGNw_EuSTCgDcYhKRA2?contactdata=uV68lnm/zPPdD90+OlDb20yKgIQIH+4q7Qh3Ys8PvdDiMLEk5moKZny39+kwEOm3/gscqCZPAr+4fZaQKuJtRD9JWEFqvC+kh9jY3gtg9FQ=&quick=true&refcode2=btn_CTA1]
I know what it takes to make progress on this challenging issue. I cannot say thank you enough to the tireless advocates who worked on the bipartisan ghost gun bill and the gun violence prevention package that passed this session here in Maryland. It took four years of hard work and bipartisan collaboration, but in 2021, I’m proud to say that I passed legislation that banned the sale, transfer, and possession of unserialized illegal handguns or “ghost guns.”
We need more leaders in Congress with this kind of experience. Leaders who know how to stand up to the corporate gun lobby and unite people of conscience to make progress.
I’m committed to doing all I can to protect our families from gun violence. I hope you’ll join me by signing my petition for federal action right now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/26GGkGNw_EuSTCgDcYhKRA2?contactdata=uV68lnm/zPPdD90+OlDb20yKgIQIH+4q7Qh3Ys8PvdDiMLEk5moKZny39+kwEOm3/gscqCZPAr+4fZaQKuJtRD9JWEFqvC+kh9jY3gtg9FQ=&quick=true&refcode2=link_CTA2]
Sign the petition >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/26GGkGNw_EuSTCgDcYhKRA2?contactdata=uV68lnm/zPPdD90+OlDb20yKgIQIH+4q7Qh3Ys8PvdDiMLEk5moKZny39+kwEOm3/gscqCZPAr+4fZaQKuJtRD9JWEFqvC+kh9jY3gtg9FQ=&quick=true&refcode2=btn_CTA1]
If we work together, we can achieve great things.
Thanks for all you do,
Lesley
When she’s not busy being a mom to her two toddlers, Lesley Lopez serves the people of Maryland as a Delegate from District 39 in the Maryland General Assembly. Since she was first elected in 2018, Lesley has rapidly become an effective legislator and leader, spearheading efforts to alleviate student debt, improve the delivery and efficiency of health care, and protect the limited financial resources of economically vulnerable Marylanders. Lesley has passed legislation to strengthen gun safety laws and guarantee the rights for all women in the state. She is an adjunct professor at George Washington University and a proud union member of SEIU Local 500. Lesley lives in Germantown, MD, with her husband Richard Kelly, and their two sons, Max and Graham.

Meanwhile, my opponent, far-right David Schweikert, has made opposition to women’s rights a core crusade of his time in Congress. He is pushing a nationwide ban of abortion with no exceptions, voted against the right to contraception, and even voted to allow states to prosecute women traveling out of state to receive an abortion.

**When it comes to protecting women’s rights and abortion access – I have a track record voters can trust.** When I was elected Chair of the Arizona Democratic Party, I took on Jan Brewer and the Republicans in the legislature who tried to limit abortion access. I worked with Democrats in Congress to fight Republican attempts to stack the courts with anti-choice judges. And after Roe was overturned, as a CEO, I guaranteed every employee in my company access to reproductive health care benefits – no matter where they lived.

**_It’s time for a change._ If elected to serve in Congress, I’ll take immediate action to enshrine the right to reproductive health care into law once and for all.** But, I cannot protect abortion access alone. I need your support.

This law, from when Abraham Lincoln was president and Arizona was a territory, mandates prison time for abortion providers and bans abortion without exceptions for rape and incest. = = Arizona is already one of 21 states with an abortion ban – and this step would push us back even further, establishing a total ban on abortion without exceptions and sending health care providers to jail. Meanwhile, my opponent, far-right David Schweikert, has made opposition to women’s rights a core crusade of his time in Congress. He is pushing a nationwide ban of abortion with no exceptions, voted against the right to contraception, and even voted to allow states to prosecute women traveling out of state to receive an abortion. When it comes to protecting women’s rights and abortion access – I have a track record voters can trust. When I was elected Chair of the Arizona Democratic Party, I took on Jan Brewer and the Republicans in the legislature who tried to limit abortion access. I worked with Democrats in Congress to fight Republican attempts to stack the courts with anti-choice judges. And after Roe was overturned, as a CEO, I guaranteed every employee in my company access to reproductive health care benefits – no matter where they lived. It’s time for a change. > Right now, legislative Republicans in North Carolina are pushing an all-out assault on the right to vote, using the advice of Trump’s hand-picked election denier, Cleta Mitchell, who was on the call helping him try to overturn the election in Georgia.
> This attack has nothing to do with election security and everything to do with keeping and gaining power.
> If you’re a young person, Republicans really don’t want you to vote.
> If you’re a college student away from home, Republicans really don’t want you to vote.
> If you’re Black or Brown, Republicans really don’t want you to vote.

## IREAD Scores Show Need for Additional Student Support
Following the pandemic, IRead scores have faced a sharp decline and about a quarter of third graders are not hitting key reading benchmarks. Unfortunately, the pandemic’s disruption to students' education came on the tail of a decade-long decline that already suggested a need for additional support for students. With the numbers we’re seeing now, it’s more critical than ever that our Legislature works to provide schools with the resources, funding and help they need. Last session, critical dollars were funneled away from K-12 to private and voucher programs, meaning most public schools will not receive the funds they need. It’s so important that we provide schools and teachers with adequate aid if we hope to ensure the best learning conditions for our students. body:
I'll be honest, Peter —
Fundraising is one of the worst parts of this job, **but just a few moments from now I’ll have to ask you to make a donation.**
Give me a chance to explain: I’m not asking this often because I like it. I do it because national Republicans and out-of-state super PACs are pledging to spend outrageous amounts of money to attack my character and **the only chance we have to respond is by collecting grassroots donations from a whole lot of people.**
Peter, _my opponents will try to turn me into someone I'm not, because they can’t beat who I am._
I’m a third-generation farmer, the Senate’s only working dirt farmer, and I’ll never stop fighting for the hardworking people that call Montana home.
**Since we officially launched my reelection campaign, tens of thousands of people all over the country have chipped in to support us.** That’s something I’m proud of, and it means that I’ll have a fighting chance to stand up to the millions of dollars the GOP will spend against me.
**But we can’t slow down, not even for a minute, because experts are already saying that this will be the most expensive election in Montana’s history.**
[**So with all eyes on our race, I have to ask, can I count on you to make a split donation between my campaign and Bob Casey right now to help us reach our end-of-month goal in 6 days? This is important. I need your help.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230825-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230825-1&refcode2=498_552475_huCo3v&akid=498%2E552475%2EhuCo3v)
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230825-1?refcode=em20230825-1&refcode2=498_552475_huCo3v&akid=498%2E552475%2EhuCo3v)**
Thanks for everything you do for our campaign. We’ve built a great team in Montana that relies on grassroots donations to keep us in the fight. Your support really makes a huge difference. I hope you know that.
All my best,
Jon

| | Fellow Republican,

Did you see the below email from our new Chairman, Jim Walsh? The Washington State Republican Party is preparing for a fight. We need to make sure we have all Republicans and conservatives recommitted to our great cause if we are going to take back our state and win again in 2024. **Read his email below, sign the pledge, and join our growing list of 'Grassroots Club' members fueling our fight.**

Chairman Jim Walsh is the new Sheriff in town. Our leadership at the state party is going to start fighting again, we are going to take the fight to the Democrats and we are going to start winning again.

But we can't win this fight without your shared commitment. **Click on the links below and sign your pledge to join us today.**

Lisa Evans
Vice Chair
Washington State Republican Party

P.S. I signed my pledge on Wednesday morning and have been a proud member of the 'Grassroots Club' since 2020. Join me today - the fight starts now!
---
|
---
| From: Chairman Jim Walsh _Jim@wsrp.org_
Sent: Wednesday, August 23 8:45 AM
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Subject: Two quick items

Peter--

As the new Chairman of the Washington State Republican Party, I see that we are at a critical point. We can find ourselves hopeless as our beautiful state is completely overtaken by the radical Left; or we can start to fight back and turn the tide of history. **I chose****to fight. And I'm asking you to join me** today.

There's no sugarcoating it: The other side has entrenched bureaucrats, the mainstream media, billionaire donors and unions all working on their behalf.... but we have YOU! Time after time, history has seen political movements and people **rise up in defiance of****tyranny**. Our time is now!

It starts with the individual and builds into a grassroots army, a body that is well organized, has a clear message and a defining purpose.

There are enough votes in Eastern Washington to overturn the whims of King County. Common-sense candidates can offer conservative ideals and win over all voters. I know. I’ve done it. The mainstream media may scoff about Republicans winning statewide. **I am telling you that we can****do it. We will accomplish all of these things. And we will do them together.** If I did not believe this, I would not have run for WSRP Chairman.
---

1\. Click on one of the red buttons and **sign your name to our pledge** that says you are committed to **fighting with me** for the next 15 months and reclaiming our beautiful state.

2\. On that pledge, please include your updated contact info so I can stay in touch with you via email, letters and texts with important updates from the WSRP about our **campaign plans**. We need everyone working together and on the same page if we are going to **defeat the****radical Left!**
---

By signing it today, with thousands of other Republicans, you send a clear message that we still have Republicans in Washington ready to fight for **our****great state and Constitution**.

When you sign the pledge, also consider becoming a member of our **Grassroots Club** by making a small monthly donation of $5, $10, or even $25 to sustain our operations for the next 15 months. 100 people giving $5 a month is far more powerful than a single donor writing a one-time $5,000 check.

With your pledge, we can look forward to leading **common sense** back to victory!

Jim Walsh

| | | Republicans are absolutely furious that Trump is finally being held accountable for his crimes, so they’re going after Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis, the prosecutor who indicted Trump for his interference in the 2020 election. House Republicans on the Judiciary Committee, led by Rep. Jim Jordan, launched an investigation into Willis, claiming her prosecution of Trump was “politically motivated.” And Republicans in Georgia are now trying to kick Willis out of office to get Trump’s case thrown out. Fani Willis is a highly qualified District Attorney. These attacks are outrageous and unwarranted. We want DA Willis to know that we stand with her against these attacks, and she should continue to do her job to hold Trump accountable and defend our democracy. [Add your name and tell Fani Willis you stand with her against Republicans’ attacks >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5909070e-8429-47bc-a1b0-6aa15cb2fe81/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | Peter,
---
| Washington wildfires have once again thrust our communities into a state of emergency.

Knowing that the devastating impact of these fires has affected countless families, their homes, the ranches and farms that bring us sustenance, and our cherished landscapes gives us a heavy heart.

While our state lawmakers have taken significant strides to boost firefighting efforts at the state level, it is painfully clear that more effective forest management by federal authorities is needed.

If the federal government is going to claim the authority to protect the environment, the job MUST be done to safeguard lives, livelihoods and property rights!

The politicization of radical climate policies makes matters worse.

It is disappointing to see these heartbreaking fire disasters become an opportunity for elected officials to push decarbonization agendas that lead to yet even higher gas prices, along with the unrealistic demand that everyone purchase costly electric vehicles.

Women have come far in 103 years... **and yet, for the first time in generations, it feels like we are moving backwards and seeing the freedoms our foremothers fought for get taken away.** Abortion, gender-affirming healthcare, birth control, a living wage – Brian Fitzpatrick and his fellow Republicans are attacking all of it. And the newest Republican in their primary for PA-01 has said, "It’s not proper for my wife or any other man’s wife to be leading the family... it's not as God intended." **It used to be that that kind of view was extreme for the GOP. clean_body: | | | | Peter, I had the privilege of sampling the bounty of Oregon during last weekend's French Prarie Farm and Feast event. Everything was locally grown! = We're so lucky to have many amazing farms and ranches across Oregon, and the Fifth District, that produce food and drink. The folks who live on them and work on them expect the government to carry out its duties when it comes to responsible land use, supporting our farmers, and lifting up rural communities. Thousands of people in OR-05 count on the Farm Bill — a major spending package that funds loans to farmers, rural development, agricultural subsidies, and critical nutrition programs such as SNAP. It is routine legislation. The House was supposed to vote on the latest Farm Bill this summer. But, far-right members of the GOP majority have held it up, demanding that we make harmful cuts to food stamps and climate programs. = = It's unconscionable to go after programs that help working folks feed themselves, and farmers protect their crops against the effects of climate change. But that's the agenda of the MAGA right. Republicans like Lori Chevez-DeRemer have failed to truly push back against extremists in their party, essentially giving their silent approval to the chaos and cruelty. It's time for new voices. The government should work for the people. I have a proven record of getting sh!t done for Oregonians, and I won't hesitate to call out extremists who hold up essential legislation like the Farm Bill. = More soon, Lynn | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Lynn Peterson for Congress |

| Peter,

The last few days have been some of the most challenging and heartbreaking for those who have lost so much. I've spent it on the ground with the Red Cross and the Department of Natural Resources, assessing the damage firsthand.

Homes can be rebuilt and possessions replaced, but loss and grief are real and hard to overcome alone. I know when we come together as a community to support each other, we are stronger in the face of hardships.

I couldn't be more grateful to our firefighters, dispatchers, first responders, police officers, state patrol, and support teams. In the worst of times, the best of us comes forward.

It will take a lot of effort and time on the ground to rebuild homes and lives. As we recover from this devastation, there is more we can all do to help. # _Remembering the 13_
---
In July 2021, just a month before the capital of Afghanistan would fall to the Taliban, President Joe Biden said that it would be "highly unlikely" that the Taliban would "overrun everything" and "own the whole country." But just a month later, that's exactly what happened. Americans watched as our citizens were forced to the rooftop of the U.S. Embassy in Kabul, waiting to be airlifted to safety. Chaos, confusion, and ultimately, catastrophe, would follow. Tomorrow will mark the two-year anniversary of the bombing of the Kabul airport that killed [13 selfless and patriotic U.S. service members](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/eba48421e3483ead/84b1004c94c34152c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and more than 170 local civilians. We owe it to them, to their friends, families, and loved ones, to never forget their sacrifice in the fight for our nation's highest ideals.

Chairman Kyle Hupfer

# 👮 _Giving the Blue the Best_
---
---
| | _**Governor Eric Holcomb** speaks at the groundbreaking of the addition to the Indiana Law Enforcement Academy training facility._**
---
This week,**Governor Eric Holcomb **broke ground on an historic expansion of the Indiana Law Enforcement Academy (ILEA) training facility.
* ILEA provides basic training to more than 600 Hoosier law enforcement officers annually and is the state’s only residential facility to house student officers who are in training from across the state.
* The project will provide a new dormitory, updated classrooms and training facilities, Indiana State Police offices, emergency vehicle track and a scenario-based training village.

**What he's saying:** "I am proud to break ground on this world-class facility so we can continue training up law enforcement officers throughout our state. It is critically important to invest in police instruction and training and Indiana is doing just that," said **Gov. Holcomb**. **Context:** In 2021 **Gov. Holcomb** supported new funding for ILEA and signed HEA 1006 into law providing a $70M appropriation.
* Through this and additional federal funds, ILEA will now benefit from a total of $95M in greatly needed upgrades.

**What else happened this week?****Gov. Holcomb[spoke](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/eba48421e3483ead/a9ea33bf46207e6ac3d6b838967d376c/40313)** during the AIM Ideas Summit.****

* At 3.2%, inflation remains more than twice the rate when President Biden took office.

August 25, 2023
Dear Friend,
Victims of gun violence, moms, youth, and advocates showed up and made their voices heard at this week's special session on "gun reform".
We can't let up now.
Our legislature used a moment that should have been focused on taking action to combat gun violence in our state to chip away at our democracy. They took action to silence legislators who challenge the status quo, removed grieving moms from Committees, limited how much of the public could be in the room, and (attempted to) ban the public from having signs to express their concerns.
If there are legislators unwilling to take action on gun violence and prioritize eroding our democracy, we've got to vote them out . Tennessee Voter Project, with your help, is committed to supporting as many progressive candidates as we can to make sure no Republican goes uncontested in 2024.
SUPPORT TENNESSEE VOTER PROJECT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]
As with any statewide endeavor, mounting this kind of effort takes resources. We're asking you to consider becoming a monthly donor today to Tennessee Voter Project to help us build our war chest. Your contribution ensures that we're ready to challenge the status quo in the 2024 elections. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]
Thanks for your support,
Tennessee Voter Project Staff

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Another really good reason to support Colin Allred
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
I was thrilled to join my friend Colin Allred as he brought his Texas listening tour to Houston over the last few days. After visiting with him and people across our community, I am more optimistic than ever about what we can accomplish together. I want to again ask for you to support his campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230822_ca_split?refcode=folf230822_ca_split]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230822_ca_split?refcode=folf230822_ca_split [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230822_ca_split?refcode=folf230822_ca_split]
There are so many reasons to support him. Truly, too many to fit in this email. But I highlight an important one here: He’s an unwavering voting rights champion.
In recent years, laws making it harder for people to vote and making it easier for political interference in our elections have not only been introduced, they have been passed in states across the country—including here in Texas. It’s not an exaggeration to say that next year’s election is essential to protecting democracy itself.
A former voting rights lawyer, Colin now serves as co-chair of the Task Force on Strengthening Democracy. We are both original co-sponsors of the Freedom to Vote Act, which would protect people’s right to vote, prohibit partisan gerrymandering, and limit the influence of dark money on our elections. It also includes two of Colin’s measures to help protect election workers and prevent political interference in our elections.
But when House Democrats have tried to pass bills protecting voting rights and the integrity of our elections, Senate Republicans have blocked them.
That’s why it’s critical that we elect Colin to the Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230822_ca_split?refcode=folf230822_ca_split]
And it’s important to remember that these are real dangers—not theoretical ones. Colin and I were both in the House Chamber on January 6 when Ted Cruz objected to the certification of the election results from the State of Arizona. We all know what happened that day, and the threats to our democracy that continue to this day.
Colin knows, like I do, that the right to vote should not be a political issue. The issues on which people base their votes, of course. But the right to have a say in the governing of our country? This should not be threatened as it is. Our democracy depends on the ability of all citizens to participate in our elections and have a say in our affairs. And we need to vote for people who will protect that right to vote, to have a say, for all Americans.
We all have a part to play in protecting our democracy, and one of the ways we can do that is by supporting candidates like Colin and campaigns that empower voters. And that’s why today I hope you’ll consider making a contribution that will be split between Colin’s campaign and mine. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230822_ca_split?refcode=folf230822_ca_split]
Together, we can do anything—including sending to Washington a new Senator from Texas who we all can be proud of!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Virginia is a huge flashpoint this year, but you might not be hearing a lot about it. That’s understandable — multiple indictments of a former president is... pretty big news.
But it’s our job to make you care about it. So please, let us explain why this is so important.
The voters of Virginia will go to the polls this November and elect their state house representatives. Republicans hold the Assembly, and Democrats have a slim majority in the Senate.
We’re backing a number of strong candidates from Military and National Security backgrounds who could swing the Assembly to Democrats and help hold the Senate. We’re donating to their campaigns, we’re providing strategic advice, and we’ll help with the ground game down the home stretch to Election Day.
We’re doing this because it’s the right thing to do — both for the candidates we’re backing and for the people of Virginia. We have a huge opportunity to change things for the better, and a small amount of money can have a huge impact.
But beyond that, it’s going to help us in 2024 — it’ll help us defend a Senate seat, and it’ll help chalk up one more state for President Biden in what’s going to be an incredibly tough campaign.

Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.

---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=a8a16d6f984844c3a53fc9b15b0f6c75&_e=tqP0R6qyRf-33GwiMtpNi9JGUvY4HUd1La46KOAIN3gCgszJNZLZ9_SUX5_w9o9pwSIijh8VmgTXr1ESEoKc8pCa8Hd4nhKilB6L03pcAv3b8M3jmkSUbLntFYq0AEDZbK39gu5c3bBJsv5Ciih5M2YDBaTghGL6Vo6Hmkfh2RxGQhyU2xTG0JheGPnYf31cdwT-_yfsBeVLd5DgPsS5U8pSdpzl0sQcI-rd0mPmPz1MK0N1uPtbmW9NUb8zDvp0vethWUaMxURmI1Lw1rnqb7Omjk-PARuE7PXPoTHfxeSDOH6rCe2Qlri_pBJVKA8cZY6jyDhu5r-h7Eia-q1RIq1h_I8TpFhDLyUgKXB_G4Z-_f_An5zrOLH-H6pAqRzckOSorvlI0Mla781eLZcaFVn1YUxx-mNr_rpXSlphNJqI6mDEV_xa7QGiqvDNDloR)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=a8a16d6f984844c3a53fc9b15b0f6c75&_e=tqP0R6qyRf-33GwiMtpNi9JGUvY4HUd1La46KOAIN3gCgszJNZLZ9_SUX5_w9o9pwSIijh8VmgTXr1ESEoKc8pCa8Hd4nhKilB6L03pcAv3b8M3jmkSUbLntFYq0AEDZbK39gu5c3bBJsv5Ciih5M2YDBaTghGL6Vo6Hmkfh2RxGQhyU2xTG0JheGPnYf31cdwT-_yfsBeVLd5DgPsS5U8pSdpzl0sQcI-rd0mPmPz1MK0N1uPtbmW9NUb8zDvp0vethWUaMxURmI1Lw1rnqb5jr3wZAb5K79E7rv4J08lKSE4WfDv_37YMKD2FfnCYgV2p7JB6iBoAx0NCSSJS9ShSCBedI6KeV8tT3MIU9ty1LGq43O-Ro7pu3hQjgvYqTyeiiXTpSQKZH4dEzOjeA413xHkFOg1VUbOYKhkN_n-yws8p-hVRHMrctvLP_a642)
---
But here's the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_

Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Peter, from the moment Louis DeJoy was appointed as Postmaster General, our nation’s postal service has suffered.

In fall 2020 – a moment when, in a swell of true democracy, there was a record number of mail-in ballots – DeJoy _purposely_ slowed mail delivery. In some areas, on-time mail delivery fell to 60% during one of the most significant moments for our democracy.

But that wasn’t DeJoy’s only alarming move. He also stood in stark opposition to President Biden’s plan to help the USPS to transition to all-electric vehicles in an effort to fight climate change. In fact, DeJoy went as far as launching his own plan to replace the majority of the USPS fleet with gas-powered trucks.
**Louis DeJoy’s worst offense by _far_ ****is his treatment of USPS mail carriers.**

DeJoy is now overworking mail carriers, cutting their pay, and refusing to staff up after many employees have quit due to deteriorating working conditions. This has, in turn, led to the remaining workers being overworked to a dangerous and sometimes _deadly_ degree.

**Peter, July was the hottest month on record – and yet, 70% of all USPS trucks don’t even have air conditioning**. DeJoy’s harsh working conditions are putting the lives of mail carriers on the line, and we must stop him.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: This is what my mother taught me
body:
| Peter, I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68652006/423747664/1020246834?refcode=em-8.25.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjBhZGE1YS03MjQzLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BAimCDVMxYXSJIVGHzVWe19mgUUhLYdAkfi_WdU-_H8=)**
_My husband and three children._
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.

We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.

My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.**

**_And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it._**

Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He’s targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It’s no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably.

With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck.

[**_So please, will you join the fight for a better future by splitting a donation of $3 between Eric Sorensen and my campaign? If we win in Florida, Democrats are virtually guaranteed to defend our Senate majority._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68652007/423747665/1020246834?refcode=em-8.25.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjBhZGE1YS03MjQzLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BAimCDVMxYXSJIVGHzVWe19mgUUhLYdAkfi_WdU-_H8=)

| | |
Last week, our community and our campaign lost Lauri Carleton, a fearless LGBTQIA+ ally to a senseless act of gun violence.
She was shot in front of Mag.Pi, her beloved boutique, for flying the Pride flag. I attended Lake Arrowhead’s Pride Boat Parade with her in June after she and her husband invited me and some of our volunteers to join them.
She was witty, funny, and had a special energy that can move mountains.
Lauri's unwavering support for the LGBTQIA+ community and her dedication to creating a safe and inclusive space within her shop touched the lives of many. She was committed to visibility as a part of changing the narrative around LGBTQIA+ rights and acceptance.
Every time the Pride flag in front of her store was taken down, she put up an even bigger one. The day after we lost her, a new flag came in the mail.
No one should be attacked for displaying the Pride flag. Hateful extremists want to make LGBTQIA+ people like me a wedge issue, dehumanizing us and targeting our allies.
As I reflect on Lauri's life and legacy, I’m reminded of the importance of standing together against hate and violence. It is a somber reminder that everyone within our communities deserves to live in safety, free from the threat of violence.
My thoughts are with Lauri’s family and friends during this incredibly difficult time. Let us honor Lauri's memory by fostering a world where love, compassion, and understanding prevail.
In solidarity,
Derek

name: Sandra, via Team Emerge
subject: we need to talk about book bans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emerge America This email was sent by Emerge
body:
| | |
---
Peter, we need to talk about book bans.
In the last school year alone, more than **1,400** book bans were proposed at the state level. With Republicans focused on advancing their dangerous and backward agenda, that number is likely to rise. I’ve always loved to read. And, as a mother, I am particularly saddened by these recent attacks on books and literature. I rely on books to show my children new perspectives and it pains me to think that my grandchildren may not have the same access my children did. Books like _The Hate U Give_ , T _he Perks of Being a Wallflower_ , and _The 57 Bus_ were huge for my kids and I would consider their education incomplete without them.

subject: We need a revival in America

Proposing new ideas and the lively debates that followed used to be something that we celebrated as a way to challenge our thinking and build real connections with other human beings.| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=167571caa4fd4e4890f7b4b9af873161&_e=AG1OGPEwK3GGz_wvalXpY3UFg0aBlLRsztOVe9xsvbha-Lh72-xUnBuUqtYXatIfMfKxpUSZO0gmrrZs6hZBS1mMa66AJ-P92uYS9if1oHBFbcvsdGxy-jBRpnvYKur4nflZvxwhY-YI2Aa1Bmnt_w90P4ND7XdXPey-LnmFt6eztXTXj2nATZ-mvvATZcA5P7tYgvyUy_RM9-znbvXpxw%3D%3D)
---
Peter, For many in America, suspicion and resentment of those with different political beliefs has often turned into hatred. Too many people view those they disagree with politically as an existential threat to their way of life.

The divisions in our country are historic, and while I know not everyone will agree with me, I believe that we need a religious revival in America to begin to heal those divisions. I don't know of any other way to reconnect people within their communities so that they see others as equals, even those they disagree with.

Proposing new ideas and the lively debates that followed used to be something that we celebrated as a way to challenge our thinking and build real ties with others. We've lost that, and it's largely happened because some decided to capitalize on our divisions to fuel grievances for their own selfish gain.

Below is a clip of me discussing this on Friday. If you agree, please share it with your social media followers or forward this email to others.

I was stunned when I watched the GOP debate on Wednesday. When the candidates were asked if they would support Donald Trump as the nominee even if he were convicted of a serious crime, only Gov. Asa Hutchinson said that he would not.

What has happened to the Republican Party is tragic.

It's time for us to put aside our resentment and focus on finding a way to remember what made America great in the first place. It's always been the strength of our people when we are working together.

The world is watching and waiting for us to recapture that image of the shining city upon a hill, serving as a beacon of hope and freedom for all. **I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can.** [Peter - I'm counting on your continued support to ensure that we can keep this important work moving forward](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=167571caa4fd4e4890f7b4b9af873161&_e=AG1OGPEwK3GGz_wvalXpYx-JTh4prcbNvxrAyleb6e6ts58dwVntwetvCLmGjdQvCgDjUCO1CrRf08HOrHRvlDaO_Al98_uFm2Zb6wTKyvFYxpmJA6dl8MnJ3yKqdiijeFq5Y7B9Ph7zeM2CUz-vMQGGTswhoP76qSe85ROarH1KmJ3W5cPbClLTq79ogyZCNuMerYaSYlWg75Em1T39a1hPzoPAwWVkYJ_z55RI4J0%3D). clean_body: Proposing new ideas and the lively debates that followed used to be something that we celebrated as a way to challenge our thinking and build real connections with other human beings.| | | Peter, For many in America, suspicion and resentment of those with different political beliefs has often turned into hatred. Too many people view those they disagree with politically as an existential threat to their way of life. The divisions in our country are historic, and while I know not everyone will agree with me, I believe that we need a religious revival in America to begin to heal those divisions. I don't know of any other way to reconnect people within their communities so that they see others as equals, even those they disagree with. Proposing new ideas and the lively debates that followed used to be something that we celebrated as a way to challenge our thinking and build real ties with others. We've lost that, and it's largely happened because some decided to capitalize on our divisions to fuel grievances for their own selfish gain. Below is a clip of me discussing this on Friday. If you agree, please share it with your social media followers or forward this email to others. "We Need a Revival in America" | | | ---|---|--- I was stunned when I watched the GOP debate on Wednesday. When the candidates were asked if they would support Donald Trump as the nominee even if he were convicted of a serious crime, only Gov. Asa Hutchinson said that he would not. What has happened to the Republican Party is tragic. It's time for us to put aside our resentment and focus on finding a way to remember what made America great in the first place. It's always been the strength of our people when we are working together. The world is watching and waiting for us to recapture that image of the shining city upon a hill, serving as a beacon of hope and freedom for all. I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can. . During my time as president of Planned Parenthood, I watched Republicans attempt to pass horrific laws to control women's bodies.

But now, with _Roe v. Wade_ no longer the law of the land, I need to be blunt with you: **Anti-choice extremists are attacking abortion access _like never before._**

In states across this country, Republicans are doing everything in their power to restrict reproductive freedom – and Mitch McConnell and his allies have threatened to pass a national abortion ban if they take back Senate control.

Political analysts say that the future of the Senate could all come down to Nevada – just like it did last year – which is why I’m reaching out today: **My friend, Sen. Jacky Rosen, is running for reelection. I’m working hard to help her win this fight, and I’m asking you to join me.**

The GOP knows the importance of Nevada, so they’re zeroing in on Jacky as a top target for defeat. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.
