The U.S. Constitution is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history. | My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different: I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to SHUT THEM DOWN , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it. We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done. I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us. Fellow American - are you ready for the revolution? America First, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence**. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. | | Peter, During the meetings we held ahead of the school year, I told our principals that I was wishing for a _"precedented"_ school year for once. Well, school closures as a result of a hurricane in LA threw that out the window just a matter of days into the academic year. But, despite that, it's been a smooth start to the school year and so many incredible things are already underway. **I'm particularly excited that, for the first time ever, every four year old in Los Angeles is eligible for free preschool and we have tens of thousands of new students in our classrooms.** I became a teacher to help my bright and curious students find their passions and achieve their goals. But too often I watched circumstances outside their control negatively impact their education and future. **That's why I ran for office as a fierce advocate for students: defending student's civil rights, securing $700 million more in annual school funding to support equity initiatives, developing dual language immersion programs, and pushing for hiring and curriculum autonomy.** And, that's why I'm running for Congress. I know we can and must do more for our kids, including:
* Universal preschool to give our kids a crucial head start.
* Equitable investment in our schools so every student can receive a high quality education with small class sizes.
* Strong STEM, arts and extracurricular programs to keep students competitive in a global economy.

clean_body: Anyone else desperate for some ‘precedented’ times? | | | | Peter, During the meetings we held ahead of the school year, I told our principals that I was wishing for a "precedented" school year for once. Well, school closures as a result of a hurricane in LA threw that out the window just a matter of days into the academic year. But, despite that, it's been a smooth start to the school year and so many incredible things are already underway. I'm particularly excited that, for the first time ever, every four year old in Los Angeles is eligible for free preschool and we have tens of thousands of new students in our classrooms. I became a teacher to help my bright and curious students find their passions and achieve their goals. But too often I watched circumstances outside their control negatively impact their education and future. That's why I ran for office as a fierce advocate for students: defending student's civil rights, securing $700 million more in annual school funding to support equity initiatives, developing dual language immersion programs, and pushing for hiring and curriculum autonomy. And, that's why I'm running for Congress. I know we can and must do more for our kids, including: Universal preschool to give our kids a crucial head start. Equitable investment in our schools so every student can receive a high quality education with small class sizes. Friends,
The State Freedom Caucus Network was launched in late 2021 to bring the most conservative members in each state's legislature together with a common mission to turn our country around from the bottom up. With 11 state freedom caucuses now up and running, we're starting to see powerful results.
Over the next few weeks, I will bring you the successes of our State Freedom Caucuses from this year's legislation sessions in each state, proving to you that the model that we built from the House Freedom Caucus in D.C. is working...and working well.
The first policy area that I'd like to highlight is healthcare. And in subsequent weeks, I'll show you what we've done on election integrity, taxes and spending, parental rights, educational freedom, and more.
On healthcare, the Radical Left would love nothing more than to create a fully socialized healthcare system. Remember Obama's infamous lie, "If you like your doctor, you can keep your doctor"?
Thankfully our Freedom Caucuses are fighting to protect you and your family when it comes to healthcare policy:
* The **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** unilaterally killed off Medicaid expansion in the Cowboy State. Going forward, the Democrats and the RINOs will keep trying to expand Medicaid, but as long as there is a WY Freedom Caucus, our members will keep killing it. The WY Freedom Caucus also successfully authored and passed two bills ([HB 127](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/70f09b21-e57b-45ca-aa7f-ea18d50751dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [SF 80](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9503df01-8a18-4e0c-a7d7-fd1fb4cd2b4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) which require healthcare facilities to allow family and clergy visitation rights during a public health emergency (like during COVID) so that patients aren't forced to suffer alone in hospitals and elder care settings.
* The **Arizona Freedom Caucus** [successfully defeated Democrat Governor Katie Hobbs' radical nominee](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a6301550-18c9-46c1-87a8-541224e09bf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to head the state's Department of Health Services. When the AZFC Chairman asked the nominee if she regretted recommending the brutal COVID lockdowns, the nominee said, "I don't know."
* The **Georgia Freedom Caucus** successfully led the efforts to kill HB 520, a massive mental health bill that carried a $1 Billion price tag, expanded government, and infringed on personal liberties. The GAFC's efforts led to nearly 500 calls per day to representatives at the Capitol. The GA Freedom Caucus also introduced and successfully led the efforts to pass SB 1, a bill to protect citizens from being discriminated against based on their vaccination status.
* The **Idaho Freedom Caucus** successfully blocked [a bloated $4.7 billion Medicaid budget](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/832f5735-5774-478f-829f-3d9658da96cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), forcing leadership to remove funding for ineligible Medicaid recipients, saving Idaho taxpayers a $150 million.
* The **Louisiana Freedom Caucus** successfully introduced and passed [HB 291](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bdc97561-c063-4a8d-b15e-ad3b732346d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a bill to ensure in-person visits at medical facilities so that no patient dies alone.
* The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** , for years, has pushed for full repeal of the state's "Certificate of Need" (CON) law. This nefarious law allows big hospitals to use the force of government to prevent competitors from coming into their area and threatening their market share. This keeps prices high and medical quality low. The SC Freedom Caucus successfully championed [Senate Bill 164](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/44b8723d-0f79-4e8b-b0ad-87109b9ed757?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which repeals CON laws in the state. The Caucus unsuccessfully introduced an amendment to eliminate the four year implementation lag in the bill, making it not fully realized until 2027, but the bill was ultimately [passed and signed into law earlier this year](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/37206daa-358c-4334-a417-6ccbba5fdde8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* The **Montana Freedom Caucus** successfully introduced and passed [HB 303](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/860ad16b-fe0d-48a4-9061-d33c0c668052?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which ensures that medical practitioners are not punished in any form for refusing to take part in procedures that violate their right to conscience.

These success stories are very real and undeniable. Imagine what we can do if we had a freedom caucus in all 50 states! If you share our vision and want to support our efforts, please donate now.
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_

body:
Don’t let the GOP threaten this vital program.
#
Peter,
This month in 1935, President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Social Security into law. Today, 88 years later, Social Security is still providing a crucial financial lifeline for millions of Americans.
**[Now, some Republicans are advancing proposals to make significant cuts to the Social Security benefits millions of seniors and people with disabilities depend on. We need to show the GOP that we won’t let them get away with this. Add your name to protect Social Security.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68653848/423753018/1191947150?refcode=dd_em_230825_1&ms=dd_em_230825_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZmNlZjAyNi03ODQzLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zjtVQs5gAidVvi9v7GsfBg1gFrEGglvtyU8hduVjSJ4=&emci=f8574761-6a43-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=afcef026-7843-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=2727974)**
I distinctly remember Republicans' applause during President Biden’s State of the Union Address earlier this year when he said cuts to Social Security and Medicare were off the table.
Just a few months later, when the TV cameras were off, GOP budget proposals shamefully included massive cuts to these very programs—and they’re saying it’s only their first step.
Senate Democrats will keep fighting to strengthen and defend Social Security. But we need folks like you behind us, showing Republicans the strong support for this program across the country.
****[Don’t let the GOP threaten this vital program. Sign the petition to defend Social Security.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68653850/423753020/1191947150?refcode=dd_em_230825_1&ms=dd_em_230825_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZmNlZjAyNi03ODQzLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zjtVQs5gAidVvi9v7GsfBg1gFrEGglvtyU8hduVjSJ4=&emci=f8574761-6a43-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=afcef026-7843-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=2727974)****

Peter, do you know
the story of the DCCC blacklist?

In 2018, AOC defeated the 4th most powerful Democrat in the House.
Corporate Democrats were reeling.

The DCCC went to extreme lengths to stop progressives like AOC from ever
winning again. The DCCC blacklisted any vendors, staffers, and
organizations that supported primary challengers to Democratic incumbents,
to weaken our movement.

The DCCC wanted to block working-class progressives like AOC from critical
campaign resources. Of course, they had no issue using corporate firms
that bust unions, work with Big Oil, and even lobby for the GOP’s
right-wing agenda.

Peter. The DCCC ended the
blacklist after it became a PR nightmare, but they laid the groundwork for
groups like AIPAC and the Moderate PAC that want to take down our
candidates. Now, AIPAC is openly recruiting against our progressive
incumbents and the establishment has been absolutely silent on the matter.

1. We don’t take a cent from corporate PACs. Our candidates' and our own

2. We don’t work with “Democratic” firms associated with union busting,
corporate America, or the GOP.
3. Our strategy pays off — we have elected Justice Democrats and grown
the Squad every cycle, while the last Chair of the DCCC lost the seat
to a Republican.

Corporate Democrats take money from Wall Street, Big Oil, Big Pharma,
payday loan companies, and union-busters. It’s clear: Justice Democrats
will fight for the people, the Democratic establishment will work for

body:
It’s time we confront these bad actors head-on.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1452%2E120351%2Ec47dIL)
Peter — America is stuck in a dangerous information crisis.
**Fox News. Tucker Carlson. Donald Trump.** These powerful right-wing engines of misinformation are endlessly spreading lies and bigotry to millions.
Right now, that’s on full display as Fox News and Trump keep spreading dangerous lies about Joe Biden and Trump’s now 4 indictments and 91 criminal charges.
As the 2024 election approaches, we urgently need credible and fact-based journalism to correct the record and stop the spread of misinformation before it spreads.
**Here at Courier Newsroom, we’re fighting back by building the largest left-leaning network of local newsrooms in America.**
[**But to go toe to toe with the likes of Fox News, we need your help. Right now, we're working to raise the resources we need to power our newsrooms and ramp up our fight against bad information. So we're asking: will you chip in $5 now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230825?refcode=em20230825&amount=5&refcode2=1452_120351_c47dIL&akid=1452%2E120351%2Ec47dIL)
On cable news, social media, and even the dark web, right-wing bad actors keep doubling down on propaganda and lies **— weakening our democracy in the process.**
Without viable alternatives, millions of Americans have found themselves trapped in an echo chamber of bad information and fake news.
**That’s where we come in.**
At Courier Newsroom, we counter bad information by reporting factual, relevant local news stories, delivered directly to those who need it most.
We already have local newsrooms in 9 battleground states staffed by real journalists who live in the communities we serve, and we’re ready to expand our network to provide good information and news to the communities in need the most.
To do that, we need your help to spread the word about the great reporting published by our talented team of journalists every day. **We know that the best antidote to disinformation is good information** , and that’s what our newsrooms take pride in delivering across the country.
**Now here’s where you come in.** We’re only able to offer free, accessible local news because grassroots supporters like you chip in what they can, when they can.
We’re planning on expanding our network of newsrooms to take on powerful right-wing misinformation engines like Fox News, Tucker Carlson, and Donald Trump. **But our work wouldn’t be possible with your support.**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: The disastrous Citizens United decision
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| I am proud to say that we are not accepting corporate PAC contributions in our campaign, and that the average contribution for my Senate campaign is $35.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3546%2E5257348%2ETj-PN3)
Derek —
It’s been more than 13 years since the disastrous Supreme Court decision _Citizens United v. FEC_ , which allowed for a surge of corporate spending and dark money donations in political campaigns.
In that time, super PACs and mega-corporations have been able to translate their dollars into political influence. Groups like Big Pharma, the fossil fuel industry, and other corporate interests can write big campaign checks to elected leaders — and hope to receive favorable policies in exchange.
Derek, this is a terrible system of campaign finance that has allowed the rich and powerful to buy our elections. And it is a top priority of mine to fix it. It’s why my first bill in Congress was the House version of the McCain-Feingold campaign finance reform legislation. And it’s also why I’m the lead author of the bill to repeal _Citizens United._
**I am also proud to say that we are not accepting corporate PAC contributions in our campaign, and that the average contribution for my Senate campaign is $35.**
Not millions or thousands of dollars, coming in from corporations or dark money donors.
But folks chipping in $5, $25, or $100 of their hard-earned money in support of our campaign and what we stand for.
Accountability. Democracy. Leveling the playing field for every Californian.
**I say it all the time: I’m so proud of this grassroots team and deeply honored by the support it gives to our movement.**
Together, we’re rejecting the massive corporate influence in our political system. We will reform the system, hopefully passing my Constitutional Amendment to overturn _Citizens United._ We’re going to unrig our system.
But to do that, and to stand up to the MAGA Republican Party’s millions of dollars in dark money donations, I need your support, $35 at a time:
**[Can you pitch in $35, our average contribution amount, today to power this grassroots movement?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2712?c0=aug2023_abs_em.2OgIJb&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20230825_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=3546%2E5257348%2ETj-PN3)**

Friend,

Donald J. Trump – who once wielded the power of the American presidency and is now seeking to retake the office – has now been criminally indicted _four times over_ for a myriad of alleged crimes.
Having served as both a former U.S. Attorney and a state Attorney General for over 20 years, I believe that the evidence to consider criminal charges against the former President for his conduct after the 2020 election is strong. Now the idea of criminal accountability for Trump is no longer in the realm of the possible - the charges are here. To be clear: Like any defendant in our system of justice, Trump must be presumed innocent until proven guilty. He deserves to have his day in court, and we must continue to let the legal process play out.
**But there is a real risk that the federal trial against the former President will take place behind closed doors – out of direct sight of the public. That would be a grave mistake.**

The federal trial over Trump’s attempts to overturn the 2020 election stands to be perhaps the most important trial in the history of American democracy. Yet, absent action from Chief Justice Roberts, no cameras will be allowed in the courtroom.
**As Americans, we deserve to see this historic trial with our own eyes – not merely filtered through the lens of political pundits and the media, or Trump’s own social media distortion machine. That’s why I’m hoping you’ll join me in demanding transparency. With the stakes for our democracy so high, and as Trump continues to ask voters for their support in his 2024 campaign for President, nothing less than full transparency with regards to his criminal trial can be accepted. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Dear friend,
August is when many new laws took effect after our historic 2023 legislative session. But there’s one of these laws that I’m particularly excited about: criminal background checks on gun sales. As a prosecutor outside of the Legislature, I see every day the impact of gun violence in our community. Stunningly, gun violence is the leading cause of death for children in the U.S. That’s why we in the House DFL pushed for years for common-sense gun reforms like background checks and “red flag” orders - and thanks to your support, they have finally become law!
This work is so important, and we can’t sit back. Republicans are already working to flip the Minnesota House and undo this critical work we did. Minnesotans deserve better than that, friend. We need your help to protect our Minnesota House DFL majority and the work we’ve done. Can we count on you to show your support with a donation today?

Friends,

It's no secret: Career Politicians (like Joe Biden) have become too comfortable in their positions of power. The political machine is NOT listening to the people anymore, especially when it comes to our economy and our safety as a nation. _**The machine tells people that it knows what 's best for them.**_

As summer comes to a close, folks all across the country are gearing up to send their kids and grandkids back to school.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68659412/423768623/-2027002553?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzNzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGYwZTYxZGEtODY0My1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=82MefDm_zA2eB8RKO7M2y0MNpcS9Bt5Wb37xFkPKc0A=&emci=d9509f46-cb42-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=8f0e61da-8643-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=3595835)

Peter,

Tomorrow is Women's Equality Day, a day created to celebrate the anniversary of the 19th Amendment's ratification — a pivotal moment in our history that granted women the right to vote.

As we observe Women's Equality Day, let us reflect on the progress we have made and recommit ourselves to the ongoing journey toward gender equality. The 19th Amendment stands as a testament to the power of determination and the pursuit of justice. It signifies the tireless efforts of countless suffragists who fought against adversity to ensure that every voice could be heard, regardless of gender. Their legacy inspires us to continue advocating for equality in all aspects of life.

But Peter, the fight for gender equity and equal rights is far from over. Since the fall of _Roe v. Wade_ , there have been unprecedented attacks on a woman's right to bodily autonomy, making it clear what's at stake in this election. Women's reproductive autonomy and right to basic health care are on the ballot this November – **and it's up to us to ensure that the voices of the extremist few don't outweigh the will of the majority of Americans.**

**That's why I was proud to vote to pass the Women's Health Protection Act through the House, and will never stop fighting to get this critical legislation signed into law. | | Peter,
---
| The Biden Admin continuously attempts to replace American traditions for our youth with obscene and monstrous policies.

What this Admin throws our American taxpayer dollars at is so outrageous we sometimes overlook _what is being taken away_ while unbelievable policies are imposed upon us. For example, Biden’s war on... **chocolate milk**. Yes, you read that right!

Biden’s Department of Agriculture is pushing a ban on flavored milk, including chocolate and strawberry, in our children's elementary and middle schools.
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=aa20d8806b&e=25844e23a8)
---
| The Biden Admin can’t even source the ‘white stuff’ being found in the White House. Why would we entrust Big Government with this scheme dictating how the nation’s children consume a calcium rich drink?

What’s even more ironic is the Biden Admin’s full-court press to **STOP** states from **BANNING** irreversible hormone therapy and puberty blockers being administered to children _while at the same time_ trying to **BAN** **_chocolate and strawberry MILK!?_**

We're all for encouraging healthy choices, but let’s leave such decisions to local professionals in our school cafeterias who CARE about Nebraska children!

**Peter, we're standing up against this latest nonsensical example of Biden's “Building Back Better," and we’re inviting you to make your voice heard with us.**

| **New laws enacted in 2023 session set to take effect Aug. 28**
Most of the new laws the Missouri General Assembly passed during its spring legislative session will take effect Aug. 28, including a prohibition on texting or cell phone use while driving, an expansion of post-partum medical coverage for mothers of newborns, tax breaks for the entertainment industry and tight restrictions on the ability of transgender youth to obtain gender affirming care or participate in school-sponsored sports.

Missouri is one of the last states to impose a comprehensive ban on texting or using a cell phone while driving, but penalties for violations are still 18 months away as police can only issue warnings until Jan. 1, 2025. Even after the grace period ends and police can start writing tickets, the law will prohibit officers from stopping drivers solely because of alleged device use.

Medicaid coverage for post-partum care, previously capped at 60 days, will now last for a full year under an expansion of the program aimed at providing more support to new mothers. Another important change to the state’s social safety net programs lawmakers approved this year ends the so-called “cliff effect” that resulted in participants losing all benefits due to a small increase in income. The state will now offer transitional benefits to make it easier for recipients to financially establish themselves through a gradual reduction of subsidies.

Making Missouri a hub for television and film production is the purpose of the new tax incentives lawmakers approved in the state’s latest attempt to create entertainment industry jobs. Previous incentives the state offered expired years ago due to concerns the revenue lost through tax breaks exceeded the economic return to the state.

A pair of new laws imposing restrictions on transgender children were the most controversial measures passed this year. One prohibits most gender affirming care for children under age 18, with an exception for youths who already started hormone therapy or puberty blockers before the law took effect. A lawsuit has been filed seeking to block its enforcement, with the judge in the case expected to rule on a temporary restraining order at any time.

The other law targeting transgender kids mandates that students can only participate on school-sponsored sports teams that correspond with their birth gender. The restrictions apply not only to K-12 sports involving public or private schools, but college athletics as well. Schools found in violation could be punished with the loss of their state funding.

Another new law of interest increases the minimum state training requirements for law enforcement officers and expands the grounds for which the Missouri Department of Public Safety director may discipline officers. Lawmakers also have authorized local counties to shield qualifying senior citizens from future property tax increases on their homes, although implementation by counties is optional and a challenge to the law’s constitutionality is expected.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=56fd3ad942&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | New laws enacted in 2023 session set to take effect Aug. 28 Most of the new laws the Missouri General Assembly passed during its spring legislative session will take effect Aug. 28, including a prohibition on texting or cell phone use while driving, an expansion of post-partum medical coverage for mothers of newborns, tax breaks for the entertainment industry and tight restrictions on the ability of transgender youth to obtain gender affirming care or participate in school-sponsored sports. Missouri is one of the last states to impose a comprehensive ban on texting or using a cell phone while driving, but penalties for violations are still 18 months away as police can only issue warnings until Jan. 1, 2025. Even after the grace period ends and police can start writing tickets, the law will prohibit officers from stopping drivers solely because of alleged device use. Medicaid coverage for post-partum care, previously capped at 60 days, will now last for a full year under an expansion of the program aimed at providing more support to new mothers. Another important change to the state’s social safety net programs lawmakers approved this year ends the so-called “cliff effect” that resulted in participants losing all benefits due to a small increase in income. The state will now offer transitional benefits to make it easier for recipients to financially establish themselves through a gradual reduction of subsidies. Making Missouri a hub for television and film production is the purpose of the new tax incentives lawmakers approved in the state’s latest attempt to create entertainment industry jobs. Previous incentives the state offered expired years ago due to concerns the revenue lost through tax breaks exceeded the economic return to the state. A pair of new laws imposing restrictions on transgender children were the most controversial measures passed this year. One prohibits most gender affirming care for children under age 18, with an exception for youths who already started hormone therapy or puberty blockers before the law took effect. A lawsuit has been filed seeking to block its enforcement, with the judge in the case expected to rule on a temporary restraining order at any time. The other law targeting transgender kids mandates that students can only participate on school-sponsored sports teams that correspond with their birth gender. The restrictions apply not only to K-12 sports involving public or private schools, but college athletics as well. Schools found in violation could be punished with the loss of their state funding. Another new law of interest increases the minimum state training requirements for law enforcement officers and expands the grounds for which the Missouri Department of Public Safety director may discipline officers. Republican presidential candidates say it is?” | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6b71176d5305/im-announcing-my-run-for-us-congress-6144853?e=d6699466fe)
---
| | [ ](https://gregwheeler.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf2f6e69e02578a82344bfc7&id=b6e5432b28&e=d6699466fe)
---
| Peter,
---
| | Have you ever wondered why your friends are tired of politics?

The answer is simple: they are tired of being misled. They are tired of double-talking. They are tired of the transparent gaslighting.

Exhibit A: CNN and White House Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre

Last summer, Jean-Pierre claimed _“we are stronger economically than we have been in history”_ **while we were dealing with the highest inflation we’d seen in almost half a century. **

**CNN mocked Republican presidential candidates at the first debate for hitting hard on the state of the U.S. economy to the point _“you’d think it was in a deep recession”. _**
---
| [ ](https://gregwheeler.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf2f6e69e02578a82344bfc7&id=52cd1464ef&e=d6699466fe)
---
| CNN reporters must have been too busy taking their orders for what propaganda they needed to spin up for the sleeping masses to check the previous day’s headlines elsewhere.
---
| [ ](https://gregwheeler.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf2f6e69e02578a82344bfc7&id=d7657becf9&e=d6699466fe)
---
| With all of the gaslighting by political pundits and Mockingbird Media telling Americans ‘everything’s fine’ and ‘these are glorious economic times’, it can be strangely gratifying to read that even **the Bureau of Labor Statistics has acknowledged that prices are 18% higher now than there were at the end of 2019!**

It hits even closer to home when they tell you to doubt your own experience! When I’m speaking at events, I like to bring up the price of a Big Mac. How many Big Mac’s could you buy with $50 today vs. how many you could buy in 2017? We all know the answer is depressing.

And the fact is, it scales up. You see it in the essentials: your housing, your gas, and your groceries. The fact is, our dollar doesn’t go as far as it used to.

**The culprit is government spending.** They don’t get it, but we do.

[**I know I’m not hallucinating over how much more expensive everything is in Biden’s America, but I’m curious about how you see it.**](https://gregwheeler.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf2f6e69e02578a82344bfc7&id=f06239cc0b&e=d6699466fe)

[**Peter, who is more accurate about the state of the American economy?**](https://gregwheeler.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf2f6e69e02578a82344bfc7&id=12577f043c&e=d6699466fe)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: | | | | | | Hi Friend, If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track. But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board. With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my FIRST debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America? | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future. name: Jayapal HQ
subject: We won't let this happen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
It's time to put the pressure on those with the power and influence to put a stop to this clear corporate grab for power.
#
Peter,
A few days ago we reached out to share the insidious plan to put Trump back in office. **Just to refresh your memory** : No Labels is a corporate-backed group with the goal to add a moderate third party candidate to ballots across the country. At first glance, this seems like a sensible option to our election process — but we're not fooled.
Now, this week, Former Maryland Gov. Larry Hogan made a point to say that No Labels' plan will ultimately launch a third-party "alternative" to undermine President Biden if former President Trump and President Biden win the nominations for their parties.
**It's time to put the pressure on those with the power and influence to put a stop to this clear corporate grab for power.[If you stand with us, please contribute to our movement and boost our fight against No Labels' plan to undermine President Biden and our democracy. ](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44742?refcode=em20230825-2850&t=1&akid=2850%2E420207%2EVU15Vj)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44742?refcode=em20230825-2850&t=20&akid=2850%2E420207%2EVU15Vj)**
No Labels is hoping to use underhanded tactics to fool people into thinking they are harmless. **But we know that this is an elaborate ploy to siphon votes from President Biden and float the election towards Trump and his far-right extremist campaign.**
Now more than ever, we need to build public pressure against No Labels and continue educating our voter base about their true intentions: _To sway the election in favor of Trump and undermine our democracy._
**This is a shame and a clear path to election interference right in front of our eyes. And we won't let this happen.[Chip in today to support our collective movement to put an end to No Labels and continue fighting for our democracy and an election system that we can all trust. ](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44742?refcode=em20230825-2850&t=21&akid=2850%2E420207%2EVU15Vj)**
In solidarity,
Jayapal HQ

name: Katie Porter
subject: Happy 107th Birthday, NPS!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
California has more National Parks than any other state (nine to be exact), so it’s important we send a real champion for the environment to the U.S. Senate.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=28790%2E3422442%2EWXSJbq)
Happy 107th birthday to our National Park Service!
California has more National Parks than any other state (nine to be exact), so it’s important we send a real champion for the environment to the U.S. Senate. Whenever I’m asked what my top priorities in the Senate would be, **I’m proud to share that combating climate change and protecting our environment are at the top of my list.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230825-2?amount=10.70refcode=EMAK25_2_NPS_20230825_V1_F&refcode2=28790_3422442_WXSJbq&akid=28790%2E3422442%2EWXSJbq)
Our National Parks have provided great memories for my family. And in Congress, I have the duty to oversee them. I’ve pushed leaders to make our parks more accessible to people with disabilities, and lead the fight to fully fund the Every Kid Outdoors program, which grants fourth graders and their families free access to National Parks.
Californians deserve a warrior in Washington fighting to protect our immense natural resources. **I’m proud to be the only Democrat in California’s Senate race rejecting money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, and Big Oil CEOs. But that means I count on supporters like you to power our campaign.[Can you chip in 10.70 today to help me continue protecting our planet?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230825-2?amount=10.70refcode=EMAK25_2_NPS_20230825_V1_F&refcode2=28790_3422442_WXSJbq&akid=28790%2E3422442%2EWXSJbq)**

Leaders We Deserve will work in partnership with a stacked Advisory Board, including Maxwell Frost, Justin Jones, and other influential leaders.

Friend, Auto workers are preparing to go on strike. The current UAW (United Auto Workers) contract expires on September 14, and workers are demanding fair pay with benefits and an end to two-tiered wages―a hiring system in which workers doing the same jobs get paid much less. As auto worker and union member Ricky Brand, a Ford worker for the last 9 years, said in a recent interview:
> _"It is hurtful to sit next to people and make less than they do and work just as hard as they do no matter what industry and what you're doing."_
Auto workers hired today are making $10 an hour less than what they made in 2007, when adjusting for inflation. In addition, the majority of workers employed by the Big Three―Ford, GM, and Stellantis (formerly Fiat Chrysler)―are now considered temporary or “supplemental” workers, even though they’re being asked to work the same hours as full time workers, but at lower wages with less healthcare and no retirement benefits. **While corporations are fighting back against workers’ rights and wages, the Big Three automakers raked in a combined $20 billion in profits in just the first 6 months of this year.** [**Click here to send a message directly to the CEOs of Ford, GM, and Stellantis and demand they meet Last year, the CEOs of Ford, GM, and Stellantis each made between $20 and $30 million―a 40% increase from just a few years ago and approximately 365 times the pay of their average employee.
Meanwhile, workers are struggling to put food on the table and stay in their homes.
The corporate assault on our communities is real. That’s why it’s so critical that we stand in solidarity with UAW workers and demand justice for all working people. **I’ve been proud to march alongside workers in Michigan, and I’m inspired by their fight for what they deserve.**
**When my** **dad started working at Ford and joined the UAW, he was able to obtain benefits after 90 days. He qualified for a pension and benefited from the Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) that was part of the union contract.** There were no tiers or temp worker status. It's time for the Big Three to do right by the workers who sacrificed so much to help them stay afloat in 2009.
[**Let’s have the backs of autoworkers in Detroit and across the country! clean_body: Fighting for the rights and wages of working people everywhere. | | | Friend, Auto workers are preparing to go on strike. The current UAW (United Auto Workers) contract expires on September 14, and workers are demanding fair pay with benefits and an end to two-tiered wages―a hiring system in which workers doing the same jobs get paid much less. As auto worker and union member Ricky Brand, a Ford worker for the last 9 years, said in a recent interview: "It is hurtful to sit next to people and make less than they do and work just as hard as they do no matter what industry and what you're doing." Auto workers hired today are making $10 an hour less than what they made in 2007, when adjusting for inflation. In addition, the majority of workers employed by the Big Three―Ford, GM, and Stellantis (formerly Fiat Chrysler)―are now considered temporary or “supplemental” workers, even though they’re being asked to work the same hours as full time workers, but at lower wages with less healthcare and no retirement benefits. While corporations are fighting back against workers’ rights and wages, the Big Three automakers raked in a combined $20 billion in profits in just the first 6 months of this year. | Last year, the CEOs of Ford, GM, and Stellantis each made between $20 and $30 million―a 40% increase from just a few years ago and approximately 365 times the pay of their average employee. Meanwhile, workers are struggling to put food on the table and stay in their homes. The corporate assault on our communities is real. That’s why it’s so critical that we stand in solidarity with UAW workers and demand justice for all working people. I’ve been proud to march alongside workers in Michigan, and I’m inspired by their fight for what they deserve. When my dad started working at Ford and joined the UAW, he was able to obtain benefits after 90 days. He qualified for a pension and benefited from the Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) that was part of the union contract. There were no tiers or temp worker status. It's time for the Big Three to do right by the workers who sacrificed so much to help them stay afloat in 2009. Together, we’re holding greedy corporations accountable while fighting for the rights and wages of working people everywhere. | | Like a rocket ship to the moon, there’s no turning back now. Our [hearing](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=a938956cc9534513b6886422164c5987&_e=QTW2Zo0vvpY7j_57L0S28SGQxLerbAU_ycpeHJQSCgPRKDPh4nh2Avo5AglQOvzFGdOXo82jZaiTufWDBTiaVlugWTfR_M0YMxehqLD1TKYmU2NiBIWng7VjR97a1hUIxvVBU7JJwVVL0o7kGnjvdsJyCGEJNHJLu61n3bujNfnfxIQBPv2hkHLhcyMc8bn0S1Zzi1fImQZOANlvXZIgI_uInkPlf685GntgIwNnY5oEXy2nZ5DM3NOEI3tCcHM-R7p0cCHVU3HYlUaZ6M2RPzKo34nJBAdhgPtWpPdLxO0%3D) on unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP) was just scratching the surface, and I promise to dig into every layer of this story. This week, I launched the UAP Caucus because I’m committed to [leading the charge](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=a938956cc9534513b6886422164c5987&_e=QTW2Zo0vvpY7j_57L0S28R0Vgx4-0swwoxqNJJxlDZfZ6-rGJ07StBgPyK_KcRDaI-CDUcrHLrizITqyInu1b1AancpAtHd1J7sSpqGRynd4WjsDPYf-nwQh8glc0FJG5gvl2roo3B_HY974k3GRmbWxPUU6TU7qsofrN6uP7rY2mBMBzwE9ZlTblxlJrROuo6c-0U5naJRgjJeBok02RewKN-JQ9XhTZU7YGXKP27-Wnam7HUlucN3ni4eL18oT8Y6Ukamf1Hxi-EEugNGlZ56FZZvYH2LXyPM3CRkv4rBbzLruzxaC6t3xFcHyzaic) to get the honest-to-goodness truth. In a letter to the Inspector General of the Intelligence Community, Thomas A. Monheim, I asked for the details that will help us get down to brass tacks. We need to know _WHO_ is involved with these UAP retrieval programs and _WHERE IN THE WORLD_ this is all going down. Hey Peter!

As one of our top supporters, we wanted to give you a quick update on what
Tammy’s been up to these last few weeks and share a few of our favorite
photos from out on the campaign trail.

Wisconsin is the small business powerhouse of the Midwest — a fact Tammy
is proud of. She got a chance to join Mayor Mike Wiza and State Rep.
Katrina Shankland for a Main Street walk in Stevens Point to discuss how
they can work to support our small businesses, foster strong local
economies, and keep our state moving forward.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-aug23.ECUt09&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230825_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=1049%2E35263%2EvoiPW- ]Stevens Point

Tammy attended a weekly meeting with the PerSisters group in Wauwatosa.
She’ll always support local activists in the pursuit of equity and
justice. What a crowd!

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-aug23.ECUt09&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230825_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=1049%2E35263%2EvoiPW- ]Tammy with the Wauwatosa PerSisters group.

From cream puffs and deep-fried bacon to cows and pig races, there’s
nothing more Wisconsin than the state fair. Tammy stopped by to meet with
fairgoers and local Democrats, and of course, had an iconic Wisconsin
cream puff. She even got to show her good friend and colleague, Arizona
Senator Mark Kelly, around!

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-aug23.ECUt09&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230825_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=1049%2E35263%2EvoiPW- ]Tammy with friend and colleague Arizona Senator Mark Kelly at the
Wisconsin State Fair.

Tammy met with folks from Waushara, Marquette, Green Lake, and Adams
counties to talk about how we can keep supporting Wisconsin’s rural
communities and economies. They make up the backbone of our state, and

| | I have been teaching for over twenty years, and I mean it when I say: nothing beats the excitement of the first day of school, Peter. Walking into school on the first day, kids are excited to see friends and teachers, teachers are excited to see their students and coworkers, and there is a sense that anything is possible. It's thrilling. School started last week for many of us, and while not without a few bumps, it's been a blast. My students are learning - and remembering - how to use technology, my colleagues are engaging with their new classes, and parents are ecstatic to have their kids back in school. **But there's a new component to my schedule this year: I'm running for Congress.** From 8 am to 3:45 pm, I am in the classroom with students. After I wrap up at school, it's time for the campaign trail. I'm reaching out to voters and supporters every evening, and sharing my vision for the second district. Teaching and campaigning both take a lot of time and effort, but the work is worth it — because it's time Utah had a member of Congress advocating for public education. **[Election season is picking up, and I need your help. clean_body: | | | | I have been teaching for over twenty years, and I mean it when I say: nothing beats the excitement of the first day of school, Peter. Walking into school on the first day, kids are excited to see friends and teachers, teachers are excited to see their students and coworkers, and there is a sense that anything is possible. It's thrilling. School started last week for many of us, and while not without a few bumps, it's been a blast. My students are learning - and remembering - how to use technology, my colleagues are engaging with their new classes, and parents are ecstatic to have their kids back in school. But there's a new component to my schedule this year: I'm running for Congress. From 8 am to 3:45 pm, I am in the classroom with students. After I wrap up at school, it's time for the campaign trail. I'm reaching out to voters and supporters every evening, and sharing my vision for the second district. Teaching and campaigning both take a lot of time and effort, but the work is worth it — because it's time Utah had a member of Congress advocating for public education. = = Education is vital. Our public schools power our communities and create a platform for success for our students. But under far-right Republican rule, our state has failed to live up to its promise — and my opponents aren't going to make it any better. Utah is one of the nation's worst investors in per-pupil education spending. Our public schools are consistently underfunded and understaffed. And rather than offer solutions to the problem, other candidates in this race advocate for banning books, making it harder for teachers to do their jobs, and diverting even more money from public education. >From the State School Board to the State Senate, I've stood up for public education funding, and I'll continue to do so in Congress. The stand we take today in defense of public education will determine just how bright Utah's future is. Every child, regardless of their background or ZIP code, deserves a real chance to succeed. = Thank you, Kathleen | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for and authorized by Riebe for Congress. |

Friend,

Before I ran for Congress, I led an initiative to make two years of preschool available to Cincinnati’s 3 and 4-year-olds. Our children deserve a strong start in life, which is why I’ve continued, as your representative in Congress, to advocate for quality public education and early childhood education opportunities for all.

Today, I’m writing to tell you about a new group that is dedicated to being a voice for children in Washington, Their Future PAC.

If our elected officials were willing to prioritize our children, we'd be in a much better place. Our planet wouldn’t be warming as quickly as it is, and our children would be able to go to school without fear of being shot.

name: Dr. Shawn Wilson for Governor
subject: We’re just getting started
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/swlogo2.png]
TEAM WILSON WEEKLY UPDATES
Peter,
A recent odometer reading showed I’ve traveled nearly 40,000 miles on the campaign so far, but we’re just getting started! Hitting every parish from Caddo to Plaquemines, East Carroll to Cameron to Washington, I’m devoted to getting the word out about the only candidate in the race with real solutions to the problems everyday Louisianans face. I’m here to bring us all together to find solutions and move Louisiana forward. Let’s geaux, Louisiana!
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sw-web]
HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
Lake Charles
I had the pleasure of participating in the LegisGator Gubernatorial Forum last weekend. I appreciate the other candidates for showing up ready to talk about the issues.
Running for office means making yourself available, and I believe the way you campaign is the best demonstration of how you might govern.
I for one am committed to being present as Governor for ALL Louisianans!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
I decided to run for Governor because when I looked at the field I realized that there was no candidate that was going to talk about things that are gonna make us healthier, wealthier, safer, and smarter.
Those are the four things that are going to drive any economy across this country and those are four ideals in my vision for a stronger Louisiana.
It's our time, Louisiana.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n9-D5jvO6mY [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n9-D5jvO6mY]
Washington Parish
The Democrats of Washington Parish banquet was a roaring success!
As I continue to speak with voters across every parish, the need for a Governor who will tackle the issues that impact our quality of life head-on becomes only more apparent.
Louisiana needs a leader with comprehensive plans to address public safety, education, healthcare, insurance rates, and more!
I'm running for Governor to be the leader Louisiana deserves.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
New Orleans
Black Education For New Orleans , BE NOLA, is an incredible non-profit that works to ensure high-quality education for Black children in New Orleans.
I had a blast at their block party this weekend, including an enlightening conversation with Civil Rights pioneer David Dennis .
I will champion increased investment in education for all, so none of our children fall behind. I am committed to working with all stakeholders to improve outcomes across the board, around the state.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
The fentanyl crisis is personal for my family - and it's wrecking families across Louisiana.
As Governor, my plan to end this public health crisis focuses on enforcement, education, overdose reversal and treatment.
I plan to ensure every bartender and public servant receives fentanyl prevention training — making sure it’s as common as CPR.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nyRaA51nwcY [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nyRaA51nwcY]
New Orleans
I was honored to receive the endorsement of IWO New Orleans this weekend and grateful for the opportunity to meet with the membership.
While the I in their name stands for their independently holding government accountable, it could easily stand for Impactful, as the group boasts some truly impressive women!
I look forward to working with you all as we work to build a Louisiana that takes better care of women, children, and families, making investments in education, healthcare and public safety.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Earlier this week I had the most amazing experience on the campaign trail. Whenever I visited the Mansion, Johnny and I would shake hands, catch up, and visit as he completed his debt to society.
While walking on Bayou Rd. for Black Education For New Orleans , I heard a voice call out, and there he was, my friend Johnny.
Freedom is precious. This election matters to him and his family, friends, and supporters. It matters to all of us.
Election Day is October 14 and Early Voting starts on September 30th. Let's geaux, Louisiana!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
“The stakes couldn’t be higher and the choice couldn’t be more clear!” - Gov. John Bel Edwards
Early voting starts September 30th.
Join Gov. Edwards and myself to keep Louisiana moving forward by voting Shawn Wilson for Governor.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IbJr8SbsV58 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IbJr8SbsV58]
Throwback to my interview with Tyronne Walker at Maroon's Black Marketplace during Essence Festival . I spoke about consensus-building and what we've achieved for Louisiana.
The majority of the contractors, suppliers, and engineers are conservatives that don't look like me. But the idea that we can work together to achieve and find consensus demonstrates collaborative leadership. If we focus on what we agree on, we'll be so busy getting things done, we won't have time to fight over the things we don't agree on.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WB5TxLLlwkc [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WB5TxLLlwkc]
GIVING PRAISE
Baton Rouge
Thank you to Baton Rouge Mayor-President Sharon Weston Broome for inviting me to join United Christian Faith Ministries , led by Rev. Mark Ellis , Sunday morning. I was honored to share in worship with both State Senator Regina Ashford Barrow & State Rep. Vanessa Caston LaFleur .
Later, I enjoyed a second service at New Hope Baptist Church pastored by Rev. Cyrus where the sermon was given by fellow Alpha and friend of 30 years, Sam Lofton .
Another long-time friend was in service and shared a historic Louisiana pin for me to have on the campaign trail. Nothing like having a piece of history as we make history!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
ENDORSEMENTS
New Orleans Independent Women’s Organization
I’m honored to announce that IWO New Orleans has endorsed my campaign for Governor by acclamation!
We are ready to get to work to ensure women and children throughout Louisiana have the support and resources they need to thrive.
Together we can:
-Reverse the trend of Louisiana's troubling maternal mortality rate
-Support families at and around the time of a child’s birth through early childhood in order to support the development of young brains
-Support paid family medical leave
-Achieve equal pay for equal work
-And more!
WILSONFORLA.COM [WILSONFORLA.COM]
The Collective PAC
I am proud to receive the endorsement of The Collective PAC , an organization committed to building Black political power through educating and equipping voters, donors and candidates with critical resources. They work tirelessly to improve our democracy by addressing the underrepresentation of African Americans in public office, and I am honored to advance their cause.
wilsoforla.com [wilsoforla.com]
Gun Sense Candidate Distinction - Moms Demand Action
I am proud to have been distinguished as a Gun Sense Candidate by Moms Demand Action , an organization that fights for public safety measures to protect people from gun violence.
The value of firearms is well known and widespread, but so is support for common sense limits like background checks and keeping guns out of the hands of those who pose a danger. As Governor I will champion legislation that honors our hunters and sportsmen and the right to protect yourself while also being considerate of the well being of our communities.
wilsoforla.com [wilsoforla.com]
UPCOMING EVENTS
New Orleans
Join me at the Louisiana Democratic Party ’s New Orleans True Blue Weeken d all weekend long.
The celebration kicks off with a Build a Better Louisiana Rally Friday night at 6:30 pm at Baldwin & Co. I’ll join fellow Democratic candidates for a night of food, fun and music, highlighted by DJ Jubilee and Mannie Fresh featuring DJ Keith Scott .
RSVP here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ldpnolarally23?fbclid=PAAaZU6OkuT201ZKA5i0-HFuj7pjTIKt_3cF7LAjoAPjAtPWbp7fhp2sbkqHg] for this event, which is free and open to the public.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
HOST SHAWN AT AN EVENT [events@wilsonforla.com?subject=Host%20Shawn%20At%20An%20Event]
To learn more about my candidacy visit wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com] .
With hope,
Shawn Wilson
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sw-web]
ENDORSE [https://www.wilsonforla.com/endorse]

name: Team Cori
subject: As a person who had abortions, Cori will keep doing everything she can to protect people’s bodily autonomy and reproductive rights.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress
body:
Representative Bush will NEVER stop pushing for reproductive justice. | |
---
Peter, Since the far-right Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ __ and stripped millions of people of their right to safe, legal, and accessible abortion care, some states moved to ban abortion while many states voted to reaffirm, restore, or permanently inscribe abortion rights into state laws. It hasn’t just been bright blue states like California and Vermont, it has included purple states like Michigan and Minnesota and red states like Kansas. Earlier this month, Ohio voters stopped an attempt by the Republican legislature to preemptively defeat an upcoming abortion rights vote. **Republicans have misjudged how important abortion rights are to everyone, and now they are paying the price at the ballot box.** We've got to make sure Democrats are paying attention. Democratic candidates in purple and red states must embrace and champion abortion rights -- not run away from it. The people are on our side! We need Democrats to champion platforms that support bodily autonomy, and vigorously advocate to expand abortion access. [**Our party must understand that protecting abortion rights isn’t just critical policy, it’s a winning election issue too! Join us in calling on all Democrats to keep fighting for abortion rights body:
Thank you for your prayers and support... | | | | | [](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=11a6498104&e=2798306028)
---
Friend,
Thank you to everyone who tuned in to the first Republican Presidential Primary Debate! It was an honor to speak directly to Americans who are making the important decision of their next Presidential nominee.
We discussed many important topics and I believe the American people have a much better understanding now of where I stand. In the below video clip, I made my opening statement at the debate. [**If you didn’t see it, you can watch it here**](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=0e4c658430&e=2798306028)**.**
[](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=8bbd4ea9a1&e=2798306028)
I was proud to stand out as the only candidate who was strongly against supporting a convicted felon for the presidential nominee. Despite the boo’s I received from Trump supporters in the crowd, I know our message is [a winning message](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=38b1bdebdb&e=2798306028) to many Americans.
The photo above speaks volumes to the state of our nation and its presidential candidates. Click the video below for the full explanation for why **I was the ONLY candidate to NOT raise my hand in support of Trump.**
[](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=58a6fadcaa&e=2798306028)
Fortunately, many other important topics were discussed including the right to life, rising crime levels, the justice system, and education.
Our campaign has seen a large bump in support since the debate. Multiple polls have reported that **our campaign’s favorability increased by the largest margin among all of the candidates.** Many news outlets have reported that I was the most “mature, measured, and thoughtful” candidate on the debate stage.
This is great momentum to have at the right time in our campaign. **Please help us keep it up but by making a contribution right now!**
| [HELP CONTINUE OUR MOMENTUM!](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=2944238c8e&e=2798306028)
---
Thank you for standing with me and for your prayers. This election is far from over and we are just getting started!
Let’s bring out the best in America!
Warmest Regards,
Asa Hutchinson
